name: Cufant
description: It digs up the ground with its trunk. It’s also very strong, being able to carry loads of over five tons without any problem at all.

moves.name: Tackle
moves.description: A physical attack in which the user charges and slams into the target with its whole body.

moves.name: Growl
moves.description: The user growls in an endearing way, making opposing Pokémon less wary. This lowers their Attack stats.

moves.name: Rollout
moves.description: The user continually rolls into the target over five turns. It becomes more powerful each time it hits.

moves.name: Rock Smash
moves.description: The user attacks with a punch. This may also lower the target’s Defense stat.

moves.name: Bulldoze
moves.description: The user strikes everything around it by stomping down on the ground. This lowers the Speed stats of those hit.

moves.name: Stomp
moves.description: The target is stomped with a big foot. This may also make the target flinch.

moves.name: Iron Defense
moves.description: The user hardens its body’s surface like iron, sharply raising its Defense stat.

moves.name: Dig
moves.description: The user burrows into the ground, then attacks on the next turn.

moves.name: Strength
moves.description: The target is slugged with a punch thrown at maximum power.

moves.name: Iron Head
moves.description: The user slams the target with its steel-hard head. This may also make the target flinch.

moves.name: Play Rough
moves.description: The user plays rough with the target and attacks it. This may also lower the target’s Attack stat.

moves.name: High Horsepower
moves.description: The user fiercely attacks the target using its entire body.

moves.name: Superpower
moves.description: The user attacks the target with great power. However, this also lowers the user’s Attack and Defense stats.

moves.name: Mega Kick
moves.description: The target is attacked by a kick launched with muscle-packed power.

moves.name: Body Slam
moves.description: The user drops onto the target with its full body weight. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

moves.name: Dig
moves.description: The user burrows into the ground, then attacks on the next turn.

moves.name: Screech
moves.description: An earsplitting screech harshly lowers the target’s Defense stat.

moves.name: Rest
moves.description: The user goes to sleep for two turns. This fully restores the user’s HP and heals any status conditions.

moves.name: Rock Slide
moves.description: Large boulders are hurled at opposing Pokémon to inflict damage. This may also make the opposing Pokémon flinch.

moves.name: Substitute
moves.description: The user creates a substitute for itself using some of its HP. The substitute serves as the user’s decoy.

moves.name: Snore
moves.description: This attack can be used only if the user is asleep. The harsh noise may also make the target flinch.

moves.name: Protect
moves.description: This move enables the user to protect itself from all attacks. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

moves.name: Endure
moves.description: The user endures any attack with at least 1 HP. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

moves.name: Attract
moves.description: If it is the opposite gender of the user, the target becomes infatuated and less likely to attack.

moves.name: Sleep Talk
moves.description: While it is asleep, the user randomly uses one of the moves it knows.

moves.name: Facade
moves.description: This attack move doubles its power if the user is poisoned, burned, or paralyzed.

moves.name: Superpower
moves.description: The user attacks the target with great power. However, this also lowers the user’s Attack and Defense stats.

moves.name: Brick Break
moves.description: The user attacks with a swift chop. It can also break barriers, such as Light Screen and Reflect.

moves.name: Rock Tomb
moves.description: Boulders are hurled at the target. This also lowers the target’s Speed stat by preventing its movement.

moves.name: Iron Defense
moves.description: The user hardens its body’s surface like iron, sharply raising its Defense stat.

moves.name: Mud Shot
moves.description: The user attacks by hurling a blob of mud at the target. This also lowers the target’s Speed stat.

moves.name: Rock Blast
moves.description: The user hurls hard rocks at the target. Two to five rocks are launched in a row.

moves.name: Fling
moves.description: The user flings its held item at the target to attack. This move’s power and effects depend on the item.

moves.name: Earth Power
moves.description: The user makes the ground under the target erupt with power. This may also lower the target’s Sp. Def stat.

moves.name: Zen Headbutt
moves.description: The user focuses its willpower to its head and attacks the target. This may also make the target flinch.

moves.name: Power Whip
moves.description: The user violently whirls its vines, tentacles, or the like to harshly lash the target.

moves.name: Iron Head
moves.description: The user slams the target with its steel-hard head. This may also make the target flinch.

moves.name: Stealth Rock
moves.description: The user lays a trap of levitating stones around the opposing team. The trap hurts opposing Pokémon that switch into battle.

moves.name: Round
moves.description: The user attacks the target with a song. Others can join in the Round to increase the power of the attack.

moves.name: Bulldoze
moves.description: The user strikes everything around it by stomping down on the ground. This lowers the Speed stats of those hit.

moves.name: Work Up
moves.description: The user is roused, and its Attack and Sp. Atk stats increase.

moves.name: Play Rough
moves.description: The user plays rough with the target and attacks it. This may also lower the target’s Attack stat.

moves.name: High Horsepower
moves.description: The user fiercely attacks the target using its entire body.

moves.name: Brutal Swing
moves.description: The user swings its body around violently to inflict damage on everything in its vicinity.

moves.name: Stomping Tantrum
moves.description: Driven by frustration, the user attacks the target. If the user’s previous move has failed, the power of this move doubles.

moves.name: Body Press
moves.description: The user attacks by slamming its body into the target. The higher the user’s Defense, the more damage it can inflict on the target.

moves.name: Steel Beam
moves.description: The user fires a beam of steel that it collected from its entire body. This also damages the user.

moves.name: Steel Roller
moves.description: The user attacks while destroying the terrain. This move fails when the ground hasn’t turned into a terrain.

moves.name: Whirlwind
moves.description: The target is blown away, and a different Pokémon is dragged out. In the wild, this ends a battle against a single Pokémon.

moves.name: Slam
moves.description: The target is slammed with a long tail, vines, or the like to inflict damage.

moves.name: Double-Edge
moves.description: A reckless, life-risking tackle in which the user rushes the target. This also damages the user quite a lot.

moves.name: Fissure
moves.description: The user opens up a fissure in the ground and drops the target in. The target faints instantly if this attack hits.

moves.name: Defense Curl
moves.description: The user curls up to conceal weak spots and raise its Defense stat.

moves.name: Curse
moves.description: A move that works differently for the Ghost type than for all other types.

moves.name: Swagger
moves.description: The user enrages and confuses the target. However, this also sharply raises the target’s Attack stat.

moves.name: Belch
moves.description: The user lets out a damaging belch at the target. The user must eat a held Berry to use this move.
